text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our training session, I spy a rare
sight—Sakura Bakushin O completely
engrossed in her phone with a sour
expression on her
face.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hnngh... Why...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Th-this has got to be a test... There's no
other explanation! A trial I
must overcome
to take my place as the ultimate class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But... But... AAARGH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Nothing much, just the dread
of waiting in line!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There's this dessert that I want to buy,
but it's really, REALLY
popular. You have to
stand in line for hours just for the
chance to buy it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I hate, hate, HATE waiting in lines!
What am I supposed to do?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Do I force myself to suffer the agony of
long lines... or do I refuse to
submit myself
to torture and give up on delicious
treats?! Gaaah, it's not faaair!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod along as she explains her
predicament. I can't picture her patiently
waiting in line either. But perhaps if she
had someone to
talk to...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, do you want sweets too? Then who
am I to deny you?! Having
you there will
surely make the line bearable as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My parents always say, "It's not where you
go—it's who you travel
with!" I never
understood what they meant until now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you're joining me, why don't we plan to
go on our next day off?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The appointed date comes, and we arrive
at the shop. We quickly get in line, but
before long, I notice Sakura Bakushin O
beginning to
fidget.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hngh... Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
One... Two sparrows! Three pigeons, and
one excellent class
representative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And... ONE missing trainer! Wait,
that's not
right! Where are you,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Th-there you are! Thank goodness,
I was starting to get
worried. Phew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been... one minute since we started
waiting. The line has barely
moved, and
Sakura Bakushin O is clearly agitated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps a conversation would help take
her mind off the line.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! An excellent question, my dear
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The cheesecake here is said to fly off the
shelves it's so fast! Isn't that
amazing?! I
had no idea cakes could fly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I can sink my teeth into that speedy
treat, I'm sure to become the
fastest
Umamusume, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I MUST get my hands on this
cheesecake! It is vital to my journey to
become the greatest class representative
and role model to Umamusume
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O seems convinced that
this dessert will magically
make her faster.
I look around for some way to explain the
rumors to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My gaze stops on a signboard in front of
the shop. Next to the picture
of their
cheesecake are the words "Best Seller!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, silly Trainer! What does being
popular have to do with flying?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what a flying cheesecake is going
to look like...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Maybe a bird? Or a plane?! Or maybe... Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps they heard about how I SOAR
down the track and modeled it after me!
Hehehe... What a naughty bakery! They
should've asked
permission!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we continue to make small talk,
the line
moves forward, ever so
steadily.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And THAT is how I managed to bring the little lost puppy back to its owner!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a speedy rescue worthy of the class
representative! If you ever
need anything,
Trainer, don't hesitate to—

text_block_list.name: Bakery Staff
text_block_list.text:
All right, just a moment, folks. We'll be
ready to serve you in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What the—how did we get to the front of
the building so fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is this some kind of miracle?! Are the
heavens thanking me for my
service as
class representative?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
N-now that you mention it, I wasn't paying
attention to the line at all
when we were
talking!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Did you know this was going to happen,
Trainer?! Is that why you
kept me talking?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you'd come up with such a
genius plan just for me!
You're in a league
all your own!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can officially vouch for your
strategic prowess!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If the heavens chose me to be the class
representative, then YOU
were chosen to
be a trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For us both to have met in this life...
How
could it be anything less
than fate—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! The time flew by so fast
AGAIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Anyway! Let's grab us some cheesecake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheesecakes in hand, we make our way
back to the academy, where
we chow
down on the delicious treat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was fantastic! Now, pull out that
stopwatch, Trainer! I wanna see
how much
faster I got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here I go... Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer... I... I can feel it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to say anything. I can
already tell—I'm the fastest
Umamusume
alive!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance down at my watch, which displays
the same time as always...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What?! B-but how... Ah, wait a minute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It must be because I went for a run right
after eating! We'll have to try
again later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... But what a great day. We got
those flying cheesecakes, and I
managed
to conquer my hatred of lines!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And none of it would've been possible
without you! That's right, the
humble class
representative always gives credit where
credit is due!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The next time I have to stand in line for
anything, I hope to make use
of your
strategic genius once again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satisfied, Sakura Bakushin O takes a break
before going for another
run.
Unfortunately, her time remains
unchanged...
